Workflow completion split preserves the checkpoint contracts I compared. Editor save and copy-and-save write the noted image and remove the backup; editor copy-and-delete copies the in-memory image and does not write it first; editor close restores the backup; input delete still confirms before deleting; input note rendering failure still aborts and stays open, while editor note rendering failure still keeps the unnoted image. This was a structural split, not a complexity-only empty wrapper, but it is untested against the saved log because the file changed at 21:49.

The prior NSNumber.intValue Int32 defect is withdrawn. On this platform intValue is Int and returned 4294967297 for that input. Sources/ImageSafety.swift:110-112 still reads the current symlink-resolved file size; that behavior change remains as reported, without the overflow claim.
